## Summary of Changes

Describe the changes proposed in this Pull Request and why they are necessary.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization / Refactoring

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines (PEP 8 for Python).
- [ ] Ran `python manage.py check` with 0 issues reported.
- [ ] Ran `python manage.py makemigrations --check` with no unapplied migrations.
- [ ] Ran `python manage.py test` and verified all tests pass.
- [ ] Added unit tests for new logic where applicable.
- [ ] Verified no sensitive keys or secrets were committed.
